Official verification resources

Know which official body to consult and what its checks can tell you. PIIK has no formal partnerships with these organisations.

Use the official process for your question. Check current coverage, fees and status directly with the authority.

Published 2026 register

EARB

Estate Agents Registration Board

Read EARB’s publication of the 2026 Kenya Gazette register of estate agents and estate-agent companies. It provides evidence of entries covered by that published register.

Review recorded 17 November 2026

Read 2026 Gazette publication →

EARB member directory · review pending

Access and limitations

Public publication. Ask EARB about current status enquiries.

This is a dated publication, not a live practising-status check. Confirm later changes and current requirements with EARB. An entry does not establish authority over a particular property.

Land services portal

Ardhisasa

State Department for Lands and Physical Planning

Access the official land-services portal for supported applications and searches. Use the appropriate official process to obtain property-specific records.

Review recorded 17 November 2026

Open Ardhisasa →
Access and limitations

An account or official fee may apply to the relevant service.

Services, account requirements and coverage depend on the property and registry. Opening the portal or viewing a title copy does not confirm ownership or transaction safety.

Guidance / FAQ

LSK

Law Society of Kenya

Read LSK’s frequently asked questions and use its guidance to identify the appropriate route for enquiries about advocates and practising requirements.

Review recorded 17 November 2026

Read LSK guidance →
Access and limitations

Public guidance. Ask LSK about its current check process.

This FAQ is an information page, not itself an advocate-status search or certificate. Confirm the individual advocate’s current status through the process indicated by LSK or by contacting LSK.

Published register

Land Surveyors’ Board

Land Surveyors’ Board

Consult the Land Surveyors’ Board’s register for listed land surveyors and the registration information it publishes. Match the person’s full details.

Review recorded 17 November 2026

View land surveyors register →
Access and limitations

Public register. Ask the Board about current licensing checks.

Treat the listing as a published register unless the Board explicitly confirms a live status service. Check the register date and current licensing or practising position with the Board. A listing does not establish parcel boundaries.

Business services gateway

BRS

Business Registration Service

Find the official route to business and company registration services and the relevant records or searches. Use the actual service result for the entity concerned.

Review recorded 17 November 2026

Open BRS services →
Access and limitations

Official records may require an account and a fee.

The homepage is a gateway, not a company-search result. Account requirements and fees may apply. Business registration does not establish land ownership, project approval, solvency or investment safety.

Regulator website

VRB

Valuers Registration Board

Consult the Valuers Registration Board for registration information and the route to checking a valuer’s current practising requirements.

Review recorded 17 November 2026

Open Valuers Registration Board →
Access and limitations

Public website. Ask the Board about the process for individual checks.

The homepage is not an individual status result or a property valuation. Confirm the person’s details and current status with the Board, and commission property-specific valuation work separately.

Published professional registers

BORAQS

Board of Registration of Architects and Quantity Surveyors

Consult BORAQS’ separate published registers for architects and quantity surveyors. Match the professional’s name, discipline and registration details.

Review recorded 17 November 2026

View architects register →View quantity surveyors register →
Access and limitations

Public registers. Ask BORAQS about current practising requirements.

A published register is not automatically a live practising-status service. Check the publication date and current practising requirements with BORAQS. Registration does not confirm project planning or building approval.

Authority to consult

EBK

Engineers Board of Kenya

Engineering registration categories and the route to checking practising status.

Independent destination review pending

Access and limitations

Ask the responsible authority about access and fees.

Confirm the appropriate category and scope for the work; a name match alone is insufficient.

Contractor register / search route

NCA

National Construction Authority

Use NCA’s registered-contractors page to consult contractor registration information and categories provided by the authority. Match the contractor’s identity and relevant scope.

Review recorded 17 November 2026

View registered contractors →
Access and limitations

Public contractor resource. Check project registration separately.

Check the record date, category and current standing with NCA. Contractor registration is separate from project registration, county approvals, land rights and a guarantee of completion.

Authority to consult

Development approvals

County government & environmental authorities

Ask the county responsible for the site to confirm applicable planning and building permissions, approved plans and conditions.

Independent destination review pending

Access and limitations

The responsible county and required permissions depend on the site.

Requirements vary by location and project. Confirm environmental approvals with the responsible authority where applicable; no single approval proves all permissions.

Authority to consult

NEMA

National Environment Management Authority

The relevant environmental assessment and licensing route for a proposed development.

Independent destination review pending

Access and limitations

Ask the responsible authority about access and fees.

Confirm whether the specific project requires an environmental licence and verify its conditions. It does not replace county or land checks.

PIIK does not operate these registers. An official record answers a specific question; it does not establish that a transaction is safe. Source review status.
